reports.title: Ingevity reports third quarter 2026 financial results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: Following solid third-quarter results, the company is narrowing its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to a range of $385 million to $395 million, maintaining the midpoint of the prior range. The company expects full-year net sales of approximately $1.1 billion and diluted adjusted EPS of $5.25 to $5.45. Free cash flow is now expected to be between $220 million and $230 million, excluding the second quarter $113.2 million litigation settlement payment, reflecting increased capital expenditures and working capital investments as the company enters 2027.

The company intends to use its strong free cash flow to maintain leverage within its long-term target range of 2.0 to 2.5 times and return capital to shareholders. The outlook reflects continued resilient performance in Performance Materials, improved year-over-year results in Advanced Polymer Technologies and continued cost pressures within Pavement Technologies. The 2026 outlook includes full-year financial results for Advanced Polymer Technologies
but excludes the divested Industrial Specialties product line for the full year and Road Markings following its April 15, 2026, divestiture.

Additional Information: The company will host a live webcast on Thursday, November 5, at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern) to discuss third quarter 2026 fiscal results. The webcast can be accessed via the Investor section of Ingevity’s website. Participants may pre-register for the event here.

Participants may also listen to the conference call by dialing 833 461 5787 (inside the U.S.) and entering access code 736418594. Callers outside the U.S. can find international dial-in numbers here. For those unable to join the live event, a recording will be available beginning at approximately 2:00 p.m. (Eastern) on November 5, 2026, through November 4, 2027, at this replay link.

Instructions for accessing the webcast and conference call, along with a slide deck containing relevant financial and statistical information, will be posted to the Investors section of Ingevity’s website after the company issues its earnings release on November 4, 2026.
